threats: T1
Password guessing / brute force (S) — `/api/auth/login`
Argon2id hashes; 5 attempts/min per IP+user; same error for unknown user and wrong password; constant-ish timing with dummy hash
T2
Session hijacking (S) — cookies
Random 256-bit token, HttpOnly + SameSite=Strict cookie, only sha256 stored in DB, 30-min expiry, sessions killed on logout/role change
T3
CSRF (T) — state-changing endpoints
Per-session CSRF token required in X-CSRF-Token for POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE, plus SameSite=Strict
T4
Privilege escalation / broken access control (E) — all endpoints
Server-side RBAC (require(permission)), least privilege per role, viewer gets a restricted projection, denials audited with generic message
T5
Stored XSS from uploaded page content (T/E) — evidence shown in UI
UI renders with textContent only (no innerHTML), strict CSP (script-src 'self', no inline), evidence truncated
T6
Malicious page executes / beacons out (I/E) — feature extraction
Pure-Python parser, no rendering, no JS engine, no network requests; declared URL is parsed, never fetched
T7
Unsafe file handling: zip slip, zip bomb, huge uploads (D/T) — upload & import

Extension + content sniffing, size cap read with read(limit+1), archive read in memory only, archive paths discarded, declared and actual expanded size limits, file-count limit, server-generated storage names
T8
SQL injection (T/I) — repository
Only parameterized queries; filter column names are fixed in code; LIKE wildcards escaped
T9
Tampering with audit records (R) — audit log

Append-only triggers block UPDATE/DELETE; HMAC-SHA256 chain keyed by secrets/audit.key (outside data/) so a copied/edited DB cannot be re-chained; writers serialised (BEGIN IMMEDIATE) so concurrency cannot fork the chain; verify endpoint returns the head hash to keep externally
Tampered or swapped model file (T/E) — `models/`
Model loaded only if SHA-256 matches its metadata (and PHISHLENS_MODEL_SHA256 when pinned) and its features exist; any load failure → rules-only + logged
Sensitive data leaking into logs/reports (I) — audit, export
Recursive redaction of secret-like keys, e-mail masking, string truncation; exports exclude raw HTML and feature dumps
Error messages leaking internals (I) — all
Stable error codes, generic messages, stack traces logged server-side only with a reference id
CSV/formula injection in exports (T) — CSV export
Cells starting with = + - @ are prefixed with '
Unreviewed config change silently alters decisions (R/T) — admin config
Versioned config with reason, explicit confirmation, audit entry with before/after, each analysis stores its config version
Denial of service via analysis flooding (D) — analyze endpoints
30 analyses/min per user incl. each page of a bulk import; uploads run off the event loop; size limits
Model learns a dataset shortcut (T, integrity of decisions) — ML model
Explanations expose it (page-size features dominated small benign pages); size-feature ablation evaluated; brand-ownership feature; fixtures checked as a generalisation test
Over-retention of hostile/sensitive page content (I) — stored samples
Admin purge + PHISHLENS_RETENTION_DAYS auto-purge of raw HTML; results keep only truncated evidence; purge is confirmed and audited
Unconfirmed privilege change / model swap (E/T) — admin API
Server-side confirm required for role/disable changes, config changes, model reload and purge; sessions of a changed user are revoked
Silent failures (R) — all
Unhandled errors return a generic 500 with a reference id and are written to the audit log as system.error
tfinal: Oversized page / zip bomb / too many files
Unauthorized request (viewer uploads, analyst opens admin)
Generic denial, logged, record not exposed

Data, config and audit chain intact
